questions.topic: Perfectly inelastic collision as the largest energy loss

questions.stem: A learner fixing a mistake gives masses 6.00 kg and 2.00 kg with velocities 4.00 m/s and 2.00 m/s; what is their common velocity after sticking?
questions.explanation: Momentum conservation gives (6×4+2×2)/(6+2)=3.50 m/s; kinetic energy is lost in this collision.
questions.hint: Use total momentum divided by total mass.
